row.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE186105 contains only untrained WT vs muscle-specific Sirt6 KO gastrocnemius (3 vs 3); there is no exercise, training, sedentary, or time-after-exercise factor in the metadata, the GEO design, or the paper's description of these RNA-seq mice (S2.4.p1, FIG4a, S4.15.p1). The paper's genotype contrast (KO vs WT) is a different estimand and cannot be relabelled as an exercise effect; the paper's transcriptomic exercise comparison uses human GSE9103 (FIG1a, S4.16.p1), a separate accession not requested here.
